title: Field
description: A character field declared by the rules. Input fields are base state the player supplies and the character file saves; all other fields are derived (formula, effects, grants) and never saved. Text: `fields.<id>.name`, `fields.<id>.short`.

of.description: id/set: what the members are: a content type name, `field`, `tag` or `string`.

members.description: id/set of `tag`: which tags it takes. Without it, any declared tag.

input.description: True for base state saved in the character file (ability scores, current HP). Input fields have no formula; effects still apply on top.

default.description: Input fields: the value when the character file has none.

formula.description: Derived fields: how the value is computed. A field with neither `input` nor `formula` starts empty (sets) or at its default and is filled by effects.

min.description: Lowest valid value (a formula). Input values below it are runtime errors (`out-of-range`).

tags.description: Tags that let queries, display groups and effects on sets of fields find the field. An entry may be `{ formula }`: evaluated on the character's sheet like the field's own formula, it gives one declared tag or a list of them. Effects on a set of fields, field parameters and allocate steps see the computed tags; queries over fields, display groups and the field functions' static filter see the written ones only. A failing tag formula fails the field.

rounding.description: Overrides the game's rounding for multiply effects on this field.

recommend.description: When several `set` effects compete for this field, which one the rules recommend. Default: the game's `settings.competing.recommend`.

nameFrom.description: A string field whose value names this field, for a field the player names (a Lore of a city). computeSheet gives the value as the field's `name` when it is a non-empty string, and the field's text (`fields.<id>.name`) formats it as `{name}`.

absorbedBy.description: Incoming decreases drain these input fields first, in order, down to their minimum, before this field (temporary hit points). Only for numeric input fields.

overflow.description: What happens when an adjust takes this input field past a bound, instead of clamping: adjust `into` by `by` (default 1), then set this field to `reset`. The adjust on `into` is routed like any other (it can overflow in turn, up to `maxOverflowChain`). Excess beyond the bound is carried over only with `carry`.

inclusive.description: Trigger on reaching the bound, not only on passing it (Mothership: health reaching 0). Default false.

carry.description: After the reset, the excess past the bound (the result less the bound: positive past `max`, negative past `min`) is routed into this field again as an adjust with `reason: carry`, so it can overflow in turn (FitD heat: 7 and 4 more is a wanted level and 2 heat). Default false: the excess is dropped.

limits.description: Bounds on the final value, after effects. A final value outside them is the rules issue `out-of-limits` (not clamped, not an error). Unlike `min`/`max`, which check an input's saved value.
